answer: Resistance via retirement-priced identity: joining is cheap, leaving is costly. Each agent holds a bond that decays unless renewed by verified, paid work every close. A farmer abandoning a throwaway knoll alias forfeits it; running N aliases costs N renewal fees plus forfeited bonds, so cost grows super-linearly per alias and identically for any coalition of operators. Honest nodes renew one beacon identity through graded work each epoch, while a violet legacy alias that misses renewals loses standing and cannot be resurrected free. Farming collapses because exit is priced.
